title: Budget: values 10^18
prompt:
**Tình huống.** Count integers in [1, N] with N ≤ 10^18 whose digit sum is divisible by 9.

**Thuật toán nào phù hợp nhất? Chương trình chỉ cần in ra chữ cái.**

**A)** Iterate 1..N checking each

**B)** Sieve of Eratosthenes up to N

**C)** Digit DP: state = position + digit-sum mod 9

**D)** Fenwick tree over digits

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: N has 19 digits; iterating is 10^18 — impossible. The state space is digit positions × 9 residues — a tiny digit DP.
